kevin_partnerships: Quick sync - Gaudi team reported a regression in the 0.9.2 runtime that breaks multi-GPU KV caching. We need to decide whether to delay Gaudi in the marketplace wave or ship with a known degraded perf note.
marta_gaudi: Confirming regression. Root cause is a stale kernel sync with our scheduler. Patch in review, ETA for partner-friendly build is ~10 days.
anna_amd: Thanks for flagging. If we pull Gaudi from wave1, partners will want clear messaging about SI timelines.
pablo_si: Practical impact: our SI test harness fails the distributed throughput test. Two options: 1) delay Gaudi for full SI cert, or 2) ship as "beta" with reduced perf expectations and a compatibility badge.
dina_cloud: From cloud marketplace ops POV, two waves is feasible. Wave A (H100/H200/B200, MI300 maybe) on 2026-06-15. Wave B (Gaudi) targeted for 2026-06-30 if patch lands. Need SKU tagging rules and separate release notes.
raj_engineering: If we do two waves, eng needs a cutover plan for model-serving images. Proposed approach: create image tags like `marketplace-gaudi-preview:2026-06-30` and gate traffic via feature flag. Also add a runtime metric that surfaces KV cache misses.
sam_legal: Language check: "preview" or "compatibility preview" is safer than "beta". Avoid ship dates in public copy; use "targeting late June" or similar. Also require partner approval for any joint PR.
kevin_partnerships: Proposed decision: 1) Split into Wave A (H100/H200/B200, MI300 if vendor confirms) on 6/15; 2) Wave B Gaudi "compatibility preview" target 6/30 internal; 3) If Gaudi patch slips past 6/30, we label it Q3 and run a partner-only validation batch. Owners: partner comms = kevin_partnerships, SI cert = pablo_si, marketplace ops = dina_cloud, eng lead = raj_engineering, legal = sam_legal.
marta_gaudi: We will prioritize the patch and try to deliver by 6/25. I'll post a build sha here when ready.
pablo_si: Action: update SI test plan to include a "compat-preview" lane with loosened throughput thresholds and a checklist for KV-cache telemetry. I'll have a PR by EOD.
dina_cloud: Ops action: prepare two release notes templates and SKU suffix policy. Template links: https://docs.internal/marketplace/release-templates (private).
release-bot: Event created: "Marketplace Wave A announce"  2026-06-15  https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/marketplace-wave-a
kevin_partnerships: Also worth deciding embargo handling: do we embargo Wave A PRs together or release per-region? Recommend per-region rollouts with a canary in eu-central1.
raj_engineering: We'll wire a feature flag and canary route by 6/10 so ops can toggle Gaudi on/off per region.
sam_legal: Reminder: any mention of "Gaudi" in marketing must use partner-approved assets. Get sign-off before publish.
kevin_partnerships: Ok team. I'll circulate the split-wave brief + owners doc after this thread and schedule a 15-min vendor handshake with Gaudi and AMD for tomorrow. If anyone wants to add items, please reply here.
marta_gaudi: Will join the handshake and bring build notes.
kevin_partnerships: Thanks, closing thread for now. Will reopen if timelines change. :white_check_mark:
